snippet.title: I Built a Free VR Social Game in Unreal Engine 5... Full Tour (Solo Dev)
snippet.description:
VR Realms is a free VR social game built in Unreal Engine 5 by one dev, releasing free on Steam in early September or October. It comes with a free Creator Kit that publishes your UE5 maps and avatars straight to Steam Workshop in two clicks. In this one I tour everything inside: deathmatch and team deathmatch modes you set up by tagging objects with no code, full body IK I built from scratch because Unreal has no VRIK equivalent, MetaHuman avatar support, synced media screens, and portals that link community worlds together. Build a world tonight, play it with friends tonight. Supports VR and desktop mode, so your flatscreen friends can join too.

▶ Play free + wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2964550/VR_Realms/
▶ Everything else: https://www.vr-realms.com
▶ Join the playtest (Discord, Sundays 6PM PT): https://discord.gg/qMZ7gZzg6A

#VRRealms #UnrealEngine #SocialVR
